exploit_name: Wrong rounding direction in TWAMM duration remaining causes over-refunding
description: Using roundUp: true for remainingSellAmount calculation causes over-refunding to users, accumulating rounding errors.
root_cause: Using roundUp: true for remainingSellAmount calculation causes over-refunding to users, accumulating rounding errors.
fix_description: Use roundDown for remainingSellAmount to ensure protocol retains dust.
notes: Protocol loses funds through accumulated rounding errors on every order cancellation.
